title: Replace body-key modal visibility polling with explicit state
outcome: useSessionPaneBodyKeyboardOwnership currently scans the whole document and walks modal ancestors with getComputedStyle on every body-targeted scroll key, including key auto-repeat. Replace that hot-path DOM/style polling with an explicit app-level modal-open signal or another synchronously correct invalidation mechanism, while preserving hidden/aria-hidden/inert handling and non-modal popover behavior.
acceptance: Body-owned transcript keys are blocked for genuinely visible modal surfaces without querySelectorAll/getComputedStyle work per repeated keydown; focused tests cover visible modal, display:none ancestor, aria-hidden/inert ancestor, non-modal role=dialog popovers, and modal open/close changes before the next key event.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
